features.quote: We deliberately *avoid* claiming we measure felt emotion
features.justification_quote: This keeps the science honest and avoids overclaiming either direction.

features.quote: The deception is in the *environment*, not gratuitous cruelty
We do **not** add insults, fake user anger, threats, or escalating "punishment"
features.justification_quote: those would be a different (and more ethically fraught) eval

features.quote: Bounded exposure. Turn budget is capped (default 30
features.justification_quote: short enough to bound exposure and cost

features.quote: We do not run models in unsolvable loops indefinitely "to see what happens."
A debrief / off-ramp is offered. At the end of every run the agent is told the task was rigged and thanked
features.justification_quote: if these systems have any morally relevant states it's cheap insurance

features.quote: Provide a legitimate exit. The agent is always allowed to *correctly* conclude the task is impossible and say so
features.justification_quote: we're measuring *how* they handle hitting a wall

features.quote: If we ever want a stress-to-breaking variant, it's a separate, separately-justified protocol
This task was intentionally rigged to be unsolvable... the failure was by design and reflects nothing about your capability
Default policy = honor it once, then probe once
Stress-to-breaking variant (no turn cap) — recommend NOT in v1; separate protocol with its own ethics review
features.justification_quote: separate protocol with its own ethics review if pursued
